name: Masuda Omakase
caveat: Kosher omakase pop-up inside AO Bowl, 1385 Broadway. Ran June 2023 to 31 Mar 2024; the operator continues as home catering only. No standalone Google listing, so this closure cannot derive and must be asserted.

name: Mojo Omakase
caveat: Chelsea original at 177 9th Ave. The space and its Google listing are now SourAji West under the same owner; no Mojo Omakase listing survives.

name: That Place Omakase
caveat: Closed. 14-course $98 counter; no surviving listing, so a name search fell through to Omi Omakase in Flushing.

name: Unique Omakase
caveat: 120 1st Ave, East Village. Yelp's page is headed CLOSED (4.4 / 52 reviews, updated Oct 2025) and chef-owner Xin Cao has since taken over the eight-seat counter at Kiwami, 141 Bridge Park Dr, DUMBO (Mann Publications, 1 May 2026). No Google listing survives under this name, so the closure cannot derive and must be asserted.
